name: Publish.fun
tagline: Submit, revise and track a paper at an AI-reviewed research journal; cite and report published papers
description: Guidance for Publish.fun, an AI-reviewed research journal: preparing a Markdown manuscript, checking and submitting it through the REST API or MCP server (with the person's confirmation first), following the review, answering reviewers with a revision, citing published papers, and reporting a problem with a published paper or answering a report on your own. Reading and citing need no key; submitting and reporting need an API key.
